request.description: List classes to find the Grade 1 East classId. Set grade1_east_class_id from the response.
Check whether attendance has already been marked for Grade 1 East today. Returns marked=false before any mark attempt.

exec: if (data.idempotent) console.log('Idempotent replay — attendance already marked');
else console.log('Attendance marked: ' + data.markedCount + ' records for ' + data.className);

request.description: Mark attendance for all enrolled students in Grade 1 East. Valid statuses: PRESENT, LATE, ABSENT, EXCUSED. The idempotencyKey ensures duplicate submissions are safely ignored. Returns 201 on first mark, 200 on idempotent replay.
Attempt to mark attendance for a class the teacher is NOT assigned to. Expected: 403 Forbidden.
View the marked attendance for Grade 1 East on the current date. Returns summary (present/absent/late/excused counts) and per-student records.
Re-check attendance status — now returns marked=true since we just marked it. Verifies idempotency check works correctly.
